corporateRelationshipEvidence.interpretation: The two Spain-facing brands are operated by different Spanish legal entities but sit within the same Gamesys/Bally corporate group. Their matching public game text is therefore useful cross-brand corroboration, not an independent replication of the underlying provider configuration or mathematics.

crossBrandFingerprint.interpretation: Two current Spain-facing Bally/Gamesys-group brands expose the same public family signature (25c-1 EUR, five fixed paylines and 95.44% RTP). This strengthens the family-level Spain-facing fingerprint but has materially less evidential independence than two unrelated operators/providers and cannot prove shared backend, pool, contribution, seed, trigger law or rules version.
